title: Ed4All unified LLM/API endpoint registry
description: Validates config/endpoints.yaml — the single source of truth for every LLM/API endpoint the codebase attaches to by name. Loaded + validated by lib/llm/endpoints.py::load_endpoint_registry. The closed Touch.provider provenance set is DERIVED from the union of every row's provenance_provider plus the 'deterministic' sentinel (see scripts/codegen/sync_provenance_enum.py); provenance_provider is a free string HERE precisely so the closed set lives in exactly one derivation, not in this schema.

version.description: Registry schema version. Bumped on a breaking field-contract change.

endpoints.description: Map of endpoint name -> endpoint definition. The name is what code attaches to (resolve_endpoint('nvidia'), build_openai_compatible_client('local'), ...).

kind.description: Transport discriminator. 'openai_compatible' = OpenAI /v1/chat/completions wire (local/together/nvidia/groq/...); 'anthropic' = Anthropic SDK (no base_url); 'claude_session' = LocalDispatcher subagent (no HTTP endpoint).

base_url.description: Default endpoint URL. Required (non-null) when kind=openai_compatible; null for anthropic / claude_session.

base_url_env.description: Env var overriding base_url. null = fixed endpoint (no override).

api_key_env.description: Env var holding the bearer key.

api_key_default.description: Fallback key when api_key_env is unset. Only 'local' uses the literal 'local' placeholder.

api_key_required.description: When true, resolve_endpoint raises EndpointKeyRequired if no key resolves and no client is injected.

loopback_only.description: Endpoint-level loopback policy flag. The answer path keeps its OWN loopback gate as a consumer overlay; this is advisory metadata. Default false.

provenance_provider.description: The closed Touch.provider value this endpoint stamps. Many endpoints can map to one value (groq/fireworks/deepseek -> local). The closed provenance set is the union of these across all rows + 'deterministic'.

vision_capable.description: Carried verbatim from the LLM/embedding precedent: whether this endpoint's model serves vision content.

vision_capable_env.description: Env var overriding vision_capable per deployment.

unverified.description: Audit flag: illustrative cloud stub not yet exercised against a live key. A post-resolve audit log surfaces the entry.
